sources.title: GitHub - perceptron-ai-inc/isaac: Perceptron's Open Source Family of ...
sources.snippet: Isaac 0.5 is a 36-billion-parameter sparse model for video understanding, embodied reasoning, and robot control. It reads images, video, language instructions, robot state, and past actions. It can answer questions about video, point to and track objects, estimate task progress, and generate robot actions.

sources.title: Perceptron Launches Isaac 0.5 to Enhance Visual AI for Industrial ...
sources.snippet: Perceptron, a startup founded by former Meta scientists, has launched Isaac 0.5, a new model designed to enhance machine interaction in industrial environments. This software enables vision-guided robots to navigate complex settings like warehouses and factory floors, extracting visual intelligence from recorded videos.
